title.narrative: Facility for international cooperation for inclusive and sustainable industrial development (FIC-ISID) India

description.narrative: Facility for international cooperation for inclusive and sustainable industrial development (FIC-ISID) is a joint initiative of UNIDO and the Government of India (through the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade) that facilitates and supports inclusive and sustainable transformation of Indian industry through facilitation of knowledge and learning and of projects and partnerships
